messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — brought up reranker v2 (fp16) vs v2-int8 on the search holdout. Overall NDCG down ~0.8 pts, but short-query cohort shows a 3–5pt drop. Anyone seen similar?
Anya: Which holdout & eval command? reproduced locally?
Sam: Holdout: search-holdout-2025-01 (~50k queries). Eval used: `./eval --model v2 --holdout search-holdout-2025-01 --quant int8 --seed 42`
David: Can you paste the slice / waterfall numbers? short/medium/long breakdown helps.
Sam: CSV snippet:
```
cohort,len,ndcg_fp16,ndcg_int8,delta
short,<=3,0.420,0.370,-0.050
medium,4-8,0.560,0.550,-0.010
long,>8,0.610,0.600,-0.010
overall,*,0.548,0.540,-0.008
```
Maria: That short-query -0.05 looks large. What are bootstrap CIs?
Sam: Bootstrap (n=1000) for short delta = -0.05 ± 0.01 (95% CI).
Anya: Two quick suspects: tokenization/padding mismatch during export and candidate ordering changes (we saw quant export touching packing logic before). Did you preserve candidate order?
Sam: Default eval pipeline had dedupe+sort step that is nondeterministic after kvpack change. Reran with `--preserve-candidate-order --deterministic-pad` and short delta shrank to -0.02.
David: So ordering explains ~60% of the effect. Remaining delta likely numeric drift from quantization (head/FFN layers).
Maria: Can we get per-layer activation stats for short queries and try asymmetric vs symmetric PTQ? Also try skipping quant on final FFN.
Anya: I'll run three configs: symmetric per-tensor, asymmetric per-channel, and skip-last-ffn. Will run bootstrap with 2000 samples for short cohort.
David: Also instrument eval harness to emit candidate order & tokenization seed per query so we can audit diffs.
Sam: I'll collect some ground-truth failure pairs (query + top3 fp16 vs int8) for manual triage. Put them under /mnt/rerank-debug/ev-<job_id>/diffs.json.
Anya: Sample collect command: `python tools/collect_diffs.py --job ev-20250301-88 --topk 3 --out diffs.json`
Maria: I'll add a slice-aware regression alert to CI — current alert only checks overall NDCG. We need short-query cohort with a tolerated delta threshold and automatic rollback trigger. ETA tomorrow AM.
David: Quick action items: 1) Add short-query cohort to CI + alerting, 2) Run the 3 quant configs + skip-last-ffn, 3) Re-run with preserve-candidate-order, 4) Collect example diffs for triage, 5) Add candidate-order logging in eval harness. Volunteers?
Anya: I'll do #2 and #4, results by EOD.
Maria: I'll do #1 and dashboard work.
David: I'll do #5 and add tokenization seed logging.
eval-bot: queued eval job ev-20250301-88; dataset=search-holdout-2025-01; model=v2-int8; configs=[sym_per_tensor, asym_per_channel, skip-last-ffn].
Sam: Thanks — when jobs finish, please attach diffs and bootstrap CSVs to this thread. Also capture top examples where MRR flips (fp16 top1 != int8 top1).
Anya: Will attach. Also one more note: verify that export used the same tokenizer version; we had a minor whitespace normalization change in tokenizer v1.2.3 -> v1.2.4 that could re-tokenize very short queries.
Maria: Good catch. I'll lock tokenizer version in CI for the short-query slice.
Sam: Great. Quick triage checklist in thread so we don't lose context. :thumbsup:
